foreign_reserves.name: Foreign Exchange Reserves
foreign_reserves.source: US Department of the Treasury / Federal Reserve
foreign_reserves.source_series_name: U.S. Reserve Assets (Table 3.12), Total minus Gold stock -- the US submission to the IMF SDDS Reserves Data Template (International Reserves and Foreign Currency Liquidity)
foreign_reserves.standardization_note: Re-pointed 2026-09-04 from FRED series TRESEGUSM052N, which FRED itself sources by relaying the IMF's International Financial Statistics re-dissemination of this same US Treasury/Fed submission -- an aggregator relay two hops removed from the primary publisher, forbidden under this repo's data-source rules regardless of licensing. Now scraped directly from the Federal Reserve's own monthly 'U.S. Reserve Assets' (Table 3.12) archive, which is this repo's primary-source route to the joint Treasury/Fed submission behind the IMF SDDS template; historical pages are read from https://www.federalreserve.gov/data/intlsumm/. The served value is the Total row minus the Gold stock row (gold is served separately as usd/gold_reserves, so including it here would double-count it) -- reconciled against FRED for six recent months (2026-01 through 2026-06) with an EXACT match after that subtraction (e.g. 2026-06: 251,262 - 11,041 = 240,221 vs FRED's 240,220.59). Coverage starts 2008-12 (December 2008): the Fed's own release archive states 'Data prior to January 2009 were published in the Statistical Supplement to the Federal Reserve Bulletin', a non-machine-readable format, so this is the practical floor for the primary source, later than FRED's TRESEGUSM052N (which the old fetcher served from 2000-01); the ~8-year reduction is accepted as the cost of removing the forbidden aggregator relay, not a data-quality regression -- see the round-2 provenance ledger for the full reasoning.
